digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center adapter transport layer
propositions: Jira Data Center rate limiting (8.6+, DC-only, off-by-default) returns 429 responses with Retry-After headers that are not currently handled by rebar's DC transport, causing hard failures on first occurrence
A static pacing policy cannot be implemented; the adapter must honour Retry-After headers when present and degrade gracefully when absent
Per-call opt-in retry for 429s must default to OFF and be scoped only to idempotent reads to prevent reintroduction of duplicate-issue failures if a 429 arrives after the server began a write

The retry opt-in flag must reach the retry layer through two distinct paths: PATH A via _call_logged (for _paged_search callers) and PATH B via direct _with_connection_retry calls (for get_comment_map's per-issue fetch, the highest-volume read in a pass)

Retry-After retry on 429 must apply up to 20% jitter (per Atlassian prescription) and clamp to MAX_BACKOFF_S, differing deliberately from ADR-0036's connectivity backoff curve which applies jitter only to the curve, not to the Retry-After branch

The four opted-in read call sites (get_issuelinks_map, get_comment_map's _paged_search, get_comment_map's per-issue fetch, get_parent_map) must pass rate_limit_retry=True, while all ten mutation call sites must continue to fail on first 429 without retry
